• Connect wiring in electrical circuits and networks ensuring compatibility of components.

description: We are looking for a skilled, multi-talented Full-Time Electrical & CCTV Technician to join our team in Bengaluru. In this role, you will be responsible for handling standard electrical wiring and maintenance, alongside installing and configuring CCTV surveillance systems. The ideal candidate must be based in Bengaluru, open to short outstation travel for specific projects, and highly motivated by performance-based incentives. Key Responsibilities Electrical Work: Execute electrical wiring, conduit piping, panel assembly, and maintenance of electrical fixtures and equipment. CCTV System Installation: Mount, position, and install analog and IP CCTV cameras, DVRs, NVRs, routers, and power supplies. CCTV Configuration: Lay network/coaxial cabling (Cat6, 3+1) and configure network settings for remote viewing on mobile apps or monitors. Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and fix faults in both electrical circuits and CCTV system hardware or connectivity. Outstation Travel: Travel occasionally to outstation project sites outside Bengaluru for short-term project executions. Requirements & Qualifications Education: ITI Certificate in Electrical/Electronics, Diploma in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or equivalent technical training. Experience: 1 to 4 years of proven experience handling both electrical wiring and CCTV camera installations. Technical Skills: Proficient with electrical testing tools (multimeters) and networking basics (crimping RJ45, configuring routers/IP addresses). Travel Flexibility: Must be fully willing to travel outstation when project demands arise (all travel and lodging expenses covered). Language: Fluency or working knowledge in Kannada is highly preferred; basic English/Hindi is a plus. What We Offer Fixed monthly salary paid on time. Performance incentives rewarded for timely project completion and high-quality installation work. Full outstation travel allowances (TA) and covered accommodation. Opportunities to work on diverse residential, commercial, or industrial projects.

description:
Job Description

A versatile and passionate technocrat with experience in executing Low Voltage Electrical Control panel manufacturing projects; execution of electric control wiring in panels, including motor starter wirings, meter wirings, RYB LED indication wirings, ramping-up projects within time & quality guidelines, as per IEC standards.

Responsibilities
Sound knowledge in selection & sizing calculations of Low Voltage switchgear components like Circuit Breakers, Busbars, Transformers, Protection Relays, CT’s/PT’s, Meters, etc.
Review Electrical Single Line Diagrams, Bill of Materials, complete electrical wiring as per technical drawings and BOM. Resolve technical issues with customers/sales, provide seamless execution of operation of electric control panel, including testing. Keeping safety as the highest importance. Familiar with Low Voltage switchgear products, meters, relays and wiring configurations, their models and configurations. Work with customers/consultants to guide on industrial standard practices.
Solve complex power challenges with economic and efficient solutions as per safety standards. Preparation of coordination study and short circuit study as per IEC standards for low voltage control panels. Review project schedule, ensure on-time delivery, coordination with customers and shopfloor managers. Collaboration with Engineering, Manufacturing, Process Engineering and Quality to achieve and maintain effective project schedules.

Qualifications

Minimum Diploma Electrical with 2 years experience as a control panel wireman. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Sound knowledge in switchgears, meters and relays, their models and prices.
• It is a Full Time Electrician job for candidates with 1 - 3 years of experience.

description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Assembly Fitter with hands-on experience in mechanical assembly, fitting, finishing, and inspection. The ideal candidate should be able to read engineering and assembly drawings, use hand tools effectively, perform mechanical fitting activities, and ensure the final assembly meets quality standards.
Key Responsibilities
• Read and interpret 2D engineering drawings and assembly drawings , with a good understanding of GD&T.

• Read and understand technical manuals, work instructions, and safety warnings.

• Assemble mechanical components using hand tools and equipment as per assembly drawings.

• Prepare machines, workpieces, tools, and auxiliaries for assembly activities.

• Repair and troubleshoot malfunctioning mechanical systems.

• Perform deburring, manual drilling, hand tapping, grinding, chamfering, and filing operations.

• Carry out soldering and other basic assembly-related operations as required.

• Operate laser engraving machines for component identification/marking.

• Perform buffing and finishing of components.

• Follow standard assembly processes and work instructions.

• Conduct quality checks during the assembly process and inspect the final product.

• Perform basic electrical wiring for fixtures where required.

• Complete and maintain assembly checklists and production records .

• Check, clean, and maintain tools and equipment used during assembly.

• Follow QMS, 5S, and workplace safety requirements.

• Work effectively with other fitters and cross-functional teams, especially during large-scale projects.

• Maintain records related to maintenance and assembly activities.

• Ensure proper housekeeping and cleanliness of the work area.

Required Skills & Qualifications
• ITI / Diploma in Fitter / Mechanical / Production Engineering or relevant technical qualification.

• Minimum 2+ years of experience in mechanical assembly or fitting.

• Good knowledge of assembly processes and mechanical fitting techniques .

• Ability to read and understand 2D and assembly drawings .

• Basic knowledge of GD&T .

• Hands-on experience with hand tools and mechanical workshop equipment.

• Knowledge of deburring, drilling, tapping, grinding, chamfering, filing, and buffing.

• Basic knowledge of electrical wiring for fixtures.

• Knowledge of QMS, 5S, and quality inspection procedures .

• Good teamwork and communication skills.

• Ability to work on large-scale projects and meet production timelines.

Preferred Experience
• Experience with laser engraving machines .

• Experience in industrial machinery, automation, SPM, or manufacturing environments.

• Exposure to IMTES and quality management systems.

• Experience in maintaining assembly and maintenance records.

• Ability to identify and resolve basic mechanical assembly issues.

description:
Machine Assembly Fitter – Industrial Machinery

About Lohia Corp Limited

Lohia Corp Limited is a leading manufacturer of advanced machinery and equipment for the Raffia and flexible packaging industry. As part of the prestigious Lohia Group, backed by a legacy of over 150 years, the company is recognised for its engineering excellence, innovation, manufacturing capabilities and global presence.

At Lohia Corp, we believe in nurturing talent, providing growth opportunities and creating a professional work environment where employees can develop their skills and build long-term careers.

Employee Benefits

* Subsidised Food Facility: Subsidised lunch and dinner provided as per shift timings.
* Timely Salary: Salary credited on the 7th of every month.
* PF & ESI: Provident Fund (PF) and Employee State Insurance (ESI) benefits as per applicable statutory provisions.
* Opportunity to work with an established manufacturing organisation backed by a 150-year-old group legacy.
* Exposure to advanced machinery, engineering and manufacturing technologies.
* Stable work environment with opportunities for learning and career development.

Job Description

Position: Machine Assembly Fitter
Department: Production / Machine Assembly

Key Responsibilities

* Carry out mechanical assembly of industrial machines and equipment as per engineering drawings and specifications.
* Perform fitting, assembly, dismantling and reassembly of machine components.
* Read and interpret mechanical assembly drawings and technical specifications.
* Perform precision fitting, alignment and installation of mechanical components.
* Assemble shafts, bearings, gearboxes, couplings, rollers and other machine components.
* Perform drilling, tapping, threading, grinding, filing and other fitting operations.
* Work with measuring instruments such as Vernier Calipers, Micrometers and Dial Gauges.
* Ensure proper alignment, clearances, tolerances and dimensional accuracy during assembly.
* Identify and troubleshoot mechanical assembly issues.
* Follow quality, safety and production standards while carrying out assembly activities.
* Coordinate with supervisors, engineers and other team members to ensure timely completion of machine assembly.

Required Skills

* Mechanical fitting and machine assembly.
* Knowledge of mechanical engineering drawings.
* Precision fitting and component alignment.
* Bearing, shaft and gearbox assembly.
* Knowledge of hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
* Drilling, tapping, threading and grinding operations.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and precision tools.
* Mechanical troubleshooting and problem-solving.
* Knowledge of tolerances, clearances and GD&T.
* Experience in industrial machinery assembly and manufacturing.

Educational Qualification & Experience

* ITI – Fitter / Mechanical or equivalent qualification.
* Relevant experience in machine assembly, industrial machinery or mechanical fitting will be preferred.

description:
About Role
As a Mechanical Service Engineer, you will be responsible for the assembly, installation, servicing, and maintenance of robotic systems and mechanical equipment. You will troubleshoot technical issues, support preventive maintenance activities, and ensure maximum machine uptime through efficient field and workshop operations. The role requires hands-on mechanical expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and a willingness to travel for customer site installations and service support. Key Responsibilities
Assembly and Service Operations:
• Assemble, install, troubleshoot, test, and maintain robotic systems and mechanical equipment.

• Perform on-site servicing and ensure proper functioning of machines.

• Diagnose issues and provide timely solutions to minimize downtime. Process & Documentation:

• Maintain proper service and assembly records.

• Prepare daily/weekly reports on work progress.

• Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Interpret Bill of Materials (BOM) and technical drawings for accurate assembly.

Requirements
Diploma in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering or related field
• Strong knowledge of mechanical assembly, hydraulics, and pneumatics.

• Ability to read and understand engineering drawings.

• Experience in robotic systems assembly and servicing is preferred.

• Additional Advantage: Experience in hydraulic pump systems.

Tools & Software:
• Hands-on experience with mechanical tools and measuring instruments.

• Basic knowledge of CAD software.

• Familiarity with MS Office and ERP systems.

Soft Skills:
• Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

• Effective time management and task prioritization.

Quality Assurance
• Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance efficiency and quality.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams for smooth operations.

• Support preventive maintenance and ensure maximum equipment uptime.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• High-quality assembly with minimal defects.

• Timely completion of service and maintenance tasks.

• Maximum machine uptime and reduced breakdowns.

• Accurate and up-to-date documentation.

• Continuous improvement in processes and efficiency.

Additional Requirements
• Willingness to travel for service and installation activities.

• Ability to handle on-site responsibilities.

Benefits
• Career Growth – Opportunities for leadership, mentorship, and continuous learning.

• Collaborative Culture – Work with a passionate and skilled team in a dynamic environment.

• Competitive Perks – Industry-standard salary and health benefits.

• Inclusive Workplace – We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity.

Equal Opportunity Employer
ANSCER Robotics is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, gender, religion, disability, or any other protected category. We believe in providing equal opportunities based on merit, skills, and business needs.

description:
Job Description – TIG Welder / ARC Welder

Company: Janani Water Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Department: Fabrication / Projects / O&M
Position: TIG Welder / ARC Welder
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka
Experience: 2–5 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled TIG Welder / ARC Welder with hands-on experience in welding and fabrication work for water and wastewater treatment plants, piping, tanks, structures and equipment.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform TIG and ARC welding as per drawings and project specifications.
• Carry out welding and fabrication of MS, SS and other materials.
• Weld pipes, tanks, supports, frames, platforms and treatment-plant equipment.
• Read and understand fabrication drawings, dimensions and welding symbols.
• Perform pipe fit-up, joint preparation, alignment and welding.
• Ensure proper weld quality, penetration, finishing and strength.
• Carry out cutting, grinding and edge preparation activities.
• Identify and rectify welding defects and minimize rework.
• Operate welding machines, grinders and other fabrication tools safely.
• Coordinate with Project Engineers, Supervisors and Fabricators.
• Maintain welding equipment and tools in good working condition.
• Follow WPS, safety procedures, PPE requirements and work-permit systems.
• Maintain proper housekeeping at the work location.

Qualification & Experience
• ITI / Welder Trade Certificate preferred.
• 2–5 years of relevant welding/fabrication experience.
• Experience in industrial piping, fabrication or water-treatment projects preferred.

Additional Requirements
• Experience in ETP/STP or water-treatment plant fabrication will be an advantage.
• Knowledge of MS and SS pipe welding is preferred.
• Willingness to travel to project sites when required.

Key Skills
• TIG Welding
• ARC Welding
• Pipe Welding
• Fabrication
• MS & SS Welding
• Drawing Reading
• Fit-up & Alignment
• Welding Defect Identification
• Safety Compliance

Pay: ₹20,800.00 - ₹43,000.00 per month

Benefits:
• Health insurance
• Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
What makes us strong? Our employees in 50 countries worldwide – all working with passion to enable high-tech applications with our solid metals: tungsten and molybdenum. Our CERATIZIT sites in India are key production and sales locations — offering precision tools and services for the automotive, aerospace, electronics and engineering sectors, with a strong focus on innovation and sustainability. Join a highly motivated team in India, where local expertise meets the global knowledge and values of the Plansee Group. Tasks & Responsibilities
• Operate induction brazing machines and perform brazing activities as per production requirements.
• Set and adjust process parameters such as power, frequency, heating time, and temperature to achieve optimal brazing results.
• Select and use suitable brazing filler metals and fluxes based on component and process requirements.
• Position components and induction coils correctly to ensure accurate heating and consistent joint quality.
• Monitor brazing cycles and ensure proper filler metal flow, penetration, and bonding.
• Inspect brazed joints for defects such as cracks, voids, insufficient bonding, and improper fillet formation using appropriate measuring and inspection tools.
• Perform basic machine setup, induction coil changes, routine maintenance, and cooling system checks. Profile & Requirements
• ITI / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Welding, or a related technical discipline.
• 2-5 years of experience in brazing operations, preferably in a cutting tool or precision manufacturing industry.
• Good knowledge of induction heating principles and brazing processes.
• Familiarity with brazing filler metals, fluxes, and joint quality requirements.
• Ability to set process parameters and operate induction brazing equipment independently.
• Experience in inspecting brazed joints and using measuring instruments.
• Basic knowledge of machine maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, and cooling systems.

What we Offer
• International collaboration in an innovative, fast-growing company
• Extensive training and development opportunities
• Attractive compensation package based on qualifications and experience Vijaya Kumar | Recruiting Team | CERATIZIT India Pvt. Ltd

description:
Sista ansökningsdag 2026-12-31 Plats: IND - Bangalore

Do you approach new challenges with passion and take responsibility for your actions Be the change you want to see and start shaping industry from the inside.

Who are we

Trelleborg India Private Limited, (Business Unit: Trelleborg Sealing Solutions) headquartered at Bangalore is a leading sealing solution provider in India. The company with about 800+ employees across India has been successful in creating strong footholds in the Sealing market of the country.

We are seeking a skilled CNC Turning Operator to join our Production team. The role is responsible for setting, operating, and monitoring CNC turning machines to manufacture precision sealing components in line with engineering drawings, control plans, and customer specifications.

Key Responsibilities

• CNC Operation & Setup: Operate and set up CNC machines as per technical drawings and production requirements.
• Quality Control & Inspection: Inspect finished components to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards.
• Process & Production Support: Support production activities, troubleshoot machine issues, and ensure smooth workflow to meet production targets.
• Safety & Compliance: Follow workplace safety procedures, machine operating guidelines, and company policies to maintain a safe working environment.

Education & Experience

• Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
• 1–3 years of experience in CNC Turning operations, including tool setting, insert selection, and understanding of tool life.
• Experience in machining/turning of metal or polymer
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, control plans, and work instructions.
• Fluent in Kannada and English.

Behavioral Competencies

• Attention to detail and quality orientation.
• Ability to work in shifts and with minimal supervision.
• Effective communication and team coordination.

Our Benefits for You

• Work in the multicultural work environment
• Work in a team
• An exciting, multifaceted, and interdisciplinary field of activity.

#ShapingIndustryfromtheInside#

Trelleborg is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we take pride in the diversity of our employees, valuing the special experience and expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. The ability to develop ground-breaking technologies is one of our key assets and our people make it happen.

description:
A CNC Machine Operator is responsible for operating Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines to manufacture precision components according to engineering drawings and production specifications. The operator ensures product quality, maintains machine efficiency, and follows workplace safety procedures.
Key Responsibilities:
• Operate CNC machines to manufacture components as per drawings and specifications.

• Load and unload raw materials and finished components.

• Set machine parameters, offsets, and cutting tools as instructed.

• Check component dimensions using measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, and gauges.

• Perform routine machine cleaning and basic maintenance.

• Identify machining defects and report machine or quality issues to the supervisor.

• Maintain production targets and ensure quality standards.

• Follow safety procedures and maintain a clean working area.

Required Qualifications:
• ITI / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related trade.

• Experience in CNC machine operation preferred; freshers may also be considered for trainee positions.

• Basic knowledge of engineering drawings and measuring instruments.

• Ability to work in shifts and follow production instructions.

Key Skills: CNC machine operation, component inspection, tool handling, engineering drawing interpretation, quality control, and workplace safety.

• It is a Full Time Manufacturing job for candidates with 1 - 3 years of experience.

description:
We are seeking a skilled Refrigeration Technician to join our team in Karnataka. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in refrigeration systems, air conditioning, and HVAC technologies. As a Refrigeration Technician, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing refrigeration and air conditioning systems in various settings, including commercial and residential environments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Install and configure refrigeration and air conditioning systems according to specifications.
- Perform routine maintenance and inspections to ensure optimal performance of HVAC systems.
- Troubleshoot and diagnose issues with refrigeration units, chillers, and AC systems.
- Repair or replace defective components and ensure compliance with safety standards.
- Collaborate with other technicians and staff to complete projects efficiently.
- Maintain accurate records of work performed and parts used.
- Provide excellent customer service and communicate effectively with clients regarding their HVAC needs.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in refrigeration and air conditioning systems.
- Knowledge of HVAC principles and practices.
- Experience with chillers and cold storage systems.
- Ability to troubleshoot and repair complex mechanical systems.
- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

If you are a motivated and skilled Refrigeration Technician looking to advance your career, we encourage you to apply. Join us in providing top-notch HVAC solutions and ensuring customer satisfaction.

description:
Job Title: ITI Electrician / Bus AC Installation Technician

Department: Electrical / HVAC Qualification: ITI Electrician

Industry: Bus Manufacturing / Automotive Air Conditioning (ACNR Bus AC Installation)

Job Responsibilities

- Install and assemble air-conditioning systems in buses as per company specifications.
- Perform electrical wiring for bus AC systems, including power cables, control wiring, relays, fuses, and switches.
- Install AC components such as compressors, condensers, evaporators, blowers, and control panels.
- Connect electrical harnesses and troubleshoot wiring faults.
- Assist in refrigerant piping installation and AC system assembly.
- Check electrical connections, continuity, voltage, and current.
- Test bus AC systems for proper cooling performance and electrical safety.
- Identify and rectify electrical faults in AC systems.
- Follow safety procedures, quality standards, and production instructions.
- Coordinate with mechanical, HVAC, and quality inspection teams.

Required Skills

- ITI qualification in Electrician or Electrical trade.
- Basic knowledge of electrical wiring and circuits.
- Knowledge of automotive electrical systems is an advantage.
- Ability to read wiring diagrams and use electrical testing instruments.
- Knowledge of bus AC installation and troubleshooting is preferred.
- Ability to work in a manufacturing or assembly environment.

Advantages

- PF and ESI as applicable

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. Job Summary: As an HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) Technician, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing various HVAC systems to ensure their efficient and reliable operation. You will work with a wide range of heating and cooling equipment, including air conditioning units, ventilation systems, and controls. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining a comfortable and safe environment for commercial and residential buildings. Responsibilities: Install, inspect, maintain, and repair HVAC systems, including heating, cooling, and ventilation equipment. E.g. Chillers , VRV, VRF, Dx, Package AC, Cassette AC, Ductable AC, Split, CSU, FCU, AHU etc. Conduct regular maintenance checks and perform necessary adjustments, cleanings, and repairs to optimize system performance and energy efficiency. Diagnose and troubleshoot malfunctions in HVAC systems and components, including electrical, mechanical, and controls systems. Repair or replace faulty parts, components, or entire systems when necessary. Brazing, Nitrogen Testing, Compressor replacement, PCB replacements, Fault Troubleshooting. Knowledge over Refrigerant systems R410,R32,R134, R407 etc. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental standards when conducting repairs and installations. Collaborate with other technicians and contractors to plan and coordinate HVAC projects, including new system installations or upgrades. Keep accurate records of all inspections, maintenance activities, and repairs performed. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, technologies, and regulations related to HVAC systems. Provide exceptional customer service by addressing client inquiries, explaining repair options, and offering recommendations for system upgrades or improvements. Requirements: Degree or Diploma or equivalent in Electrical / Mechanical / HVAC/; completion of an HVAC certification or apprenticeship program is preferred. Proven experience as an HVAC SME or similar role. Valid HVAC technician license/certification (if required by local regulations). Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, components, and troubleshooting techniques. Proficiency in reading schematics, blueprints, and technical manuals. Familiarity with electrical and refrigeration principles. Ability to use a variety of hand and power tools to perform repairs and installations. Excellent problem-solving and diagnostic skills. Strong attention to detail and quality workmanship. Physical ability to climb ladders, lift heavy equipment, and work in confined spaces. Good communication and customer service skills. Note: The job description provided above is a general outline of typical job duties and requirements for an HVAC Technician. We are looking for enthusiastic and technically motivated Diploma and Graduate Engineer Trainees to join our SPDT Department. The selected candidates will be trained in precision machining operations, machine handling, production activities, and quality requirements related to optical component manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities
• Assist in operating and monitoring SPDT machines under the guidance of senior technicians and engineers.
• Understand precision machining processes and manufacturing techniques.
• Assist in setting up jobs, tools, fixtures, and workpieces as per production requirements.
• Read and understand engineering drawings, technical specifications, and work instructions.
• Monitor machining parameters and ensure operations are carried out as per defined procedures.
• Perform basic inspection and dimensional measurements using precision measuring instruments.

• Follow safety procedures and maintain discipline on the shopfloor.
• Coordinate with Production, Quality, and Maintenance teams to ensure smooth operations.
• Support continuous improvement activities to improve productivity and product quality.

Required Technical Skills
• Basic knowledge of mechanical engineering and manufacturing processes.
• Understanding of engineering drawings and basic GD&T.
• Knowledge of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Dial Gauge, etc.
• Basic understanding of CNC machining and precision machining concepts.
• Basic computer knowledge and documentation skills.

Eligibility Criteria
• Diploma in Mechanical Engineering for DET positions.
• B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering for GET positions.
• Freshers are welcome to apply.
• Candidates with 0-1 years of experience in manufacturing or machining environments will be preferred.
• Willingness to learn precision machining and work in a production environment.

Preferred Candidate Profile
• Good technical aptitude and learning ability.
• Attention to detail and accuracy.
• Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team.
• Good communication and coordination skills.
• Ability to follow instructions and maintain workplace discipline.

ADVIK is a leading manufacturer of precision components and systems for automotive markets worldwide and has grown exponentially over the last 20 years maintaining a robust EBITDA. description:
Summary:

This is a full-time role in TNT, located in Attibele, Bangalore for a “ Nesting Engineer”. The duties for this role include but are not limited to, working closely with the Team Lead to develop shop drawings, fabrication / erection drawings with CAD and Tekla software and especially “nesting for steel structures and pre-engineered buildings”.

Role:
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, Tekla, ProNest, Most2D or other industry-related nesting software.
• Ability to read and understand architectural and structural drawings.
• Experience in generating fabrication drawings, shop and erection drawings for steel structures and pre-engineered buildings.
• Experience with plasma cutting and other related software.
• Hands-on experience in generating CNC files for the plasma machines using Most2D, ProNest or any other nesting software.
• Work with shop personnel to resolve issues arising in the manufacturing process, including reviewing punch lists for completeness against the contract documents, BOMS and cut sheets, fabricating fit-in-place assemblies, pieces or assemblies that require cutting, grinding, welding and final finishing in order to match approved shop drawings.
• Knowledge about raw material sizes and industry standards.
• Ability to achieve minimum scrap percentage with efficient nesting process.

Qualification & Abilities:
• Degree or Diploma in Civil/Mechanical Engineering or equivalent work experience.
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
• Self-directed and self-motivated with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed objectives.
• Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and work within a team environment.
• Minimum 1-2 yrs of experience in same field of nesting or freshers can also apply with auto cad knowledge.

description:
Design Engineer (SolidWorks / Creo)

Company: Dot Workplace Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Jigani, Bangalore, Karnataka
Department: Design & Engineering
Designation: Design Engineer
Industry: Customized Furniture Manufacturing
Experience: 2+ Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Design Engineer with hands-on experience in SolidWorks and/or Creo to develop 2D drawings and 3D models for customized furniture products. The candidate should have a good understanding of furniture design, engineering drawings, material specifications, and manufacturing processes, with the ability to convert concepts and customer requirements into accurate technical drawings and production-ready designs.

Key Responsibilities
• Create and modify 2D engineering drawings and 3D models of customized furniture products.
• Prepare detailed drawings, assembly drawings, fabrication drawings, and exploded views using SolidWorks or Creo.
• Develop furniture designs based on customer requirements, project specifications, and design concepts.
• Prepare technical drawings with dimensions, tolerances, material specifications, and hardware details.
• Design furniture components such as workstations, office tables, storage units, cabinets, partitions, and modular furniture.
• Coordinate with the Production, Purchase, Projects, and Quality teams to ensure designs are suitable for manufacturing.
• Revise drawings based on design changes, customer feedback, and production requirements.
• Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), cutting details, and component specifications as required.
• Ensure design accuracy, material optimization, and cost-effective manufacturing.
• Support prototype development, design validation, and resolution of production-related design issues.
• Maintain proper documentation and version control of drawings and design files.

Required Skills & Qualifications
• Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Design Engineer.
• Proficiency in SolidWorks and/or Creo Parametric.
• Strong knowledge of 2D drafting and 3D modelling.
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and assembly details.
• Knowledge of customized furniture design, modular furniture, or interior fit-out products is preferred.
• Understanding of furniture materials such as plywood, MDF, particle board, laminates, metal sections, and hardware fittings.
• Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication, assembly, and production drawings.
• Basic understanding of BOM preparation and material specifications.
• Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and coordination abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Accuracy and quality of 2D drawings and 3D models.
• Timely completion of design assignments.
• Reduction in drawing errors and production rework.
• Compliance with customer specifications and manufacturing requirements.
• Effective coordination with production and project teams.

Pay: From ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:
• Food provided
• Health insurance
• Life insurance
• Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
Diploma Engineer trainee - Field Service

Job Description

UPS System service Engineer:

A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) engineer installs, maintains, and repairs UPS systems to ensure continuous power for critical equipment. This role often involves troubleshooting technical issues, performing preventative maintenance, and providing customer support. They also conduct site surveys, design systems, and manage project timelines.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

- Installation and Commissioning:

Installing and setting up new UPS systems, including associated equipment like transfer switches and power distribution units.

- Onsite Maintenance and Repair:

Performing routine maintenance, diagnosing and repairing faults, and replacing components like capacitors & batteries.

Configure, and maintain UPS systems in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry best practices.

Conduct routine maintenance for AC / DC Power Systems Hardware and testing of UPS systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

Performing routine maintenance of Li-ion / Nicad / Sealed Lead Battery Maintenance.

Drafting of service reports following Breakdown / maintenance visits.

- Onsite Troubleshooting:

Identifying and resolving technical issues with UPS systems, often using diagnostic tools and software.

Maintain accurate records of work performed, and parts used in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Remote support / corrective attendance on short notice to priority sites during critical system failures / doomsday scenarios.

Development of upgrade plans to suit client needs. System modifications / upgrades.

- Customer Support:

Providing technical support to clients, answering questions, and training them on the proper use of UPS systems.

Work with clients to identify their power requirements and recommend appropriate UPS solutions.

- Documentation:

This role also has a customer facing element to it, so good email communications and literacy/report writing skills are a must.

Maintaining accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and site visits.

Able to read and provide Single Line Diagram.

- Safety:

Adhering to safety regulations and procedures when working with electrical equipment.

- Project Management:

Managing project timelines and ensuring successful completion of installation and maintenance tasks.

Collaborate with other team members and subcontractors to complete projects on time and within budget.

- Site Assessments:

Evaluating customer sites to determine the appropriate UPS system requirements.

Qualifications:

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

- Qualification in diploma / degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering

- A strong understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including power distribution, automatic Transfer Switch, PDU, SKRU and related components
- Solid, demonstrable troubleshooting/fault-diagnostics skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with clients and team members
- A commitment to providing excellent customer service and support

description:
Job Title: Project/Site Engineer – Electrical

Location: Bidadi, Bangalore

Experience: 1–5 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical Engineering

No. of Positions: 3

Salary: ₹3–7 LPA

Job Summary

We are looking for Electrical Project/Site Engineers to manage and coordinate electrical project execution at site, ensuring quality, safety, timely completion, and adherence to technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

- Coordinate and execute electrical installation and project activities at site.

- Plan and monitor project activities, schedules, manpower, and materials.

- Read and interpret electrical drawings and technical specifications.

- Coordinate with suppliers, technicians, subcontractors, and clients.

- Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and safety standards.

- Prepare material requirements and support estimation/costing activities.

- Monitor project progress and prepare site reports.

- Identify and resolve site-level technical and execution issues.

- Ensure compliance with electrical codes, standards, and safety procedures.

- Support project documentation and client coordination.

Requirements

- B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical Engineering.

- 1–5 years of relevant experience in electrical project/site execution.

- Experience in commercial/industrial electrical projects preferred.

- Knowledge of electrical systems, codes, and standards.

- Basic knowledge of AutoCAD.

- Exposure to electrical estimation and material planning is an advantage.

- Kannada proficiency is mandatory.

- Willingness to work at the Bidadi project site.

description:
Company: Foyer2Attic Design Studio
Location: Bangalore
Experience: 1–2 years in interior design and execution projects
Reports to: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager

About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Site Supervisor to oversee day-to-day work at interior project sites. The role involves coordinating workers and vendors, monitoring progress, checking workmanship, and ensuring execution follows approved drawings, specifications, and schedules.

Key Responsibilities
• Supervise daily site activities, including carpentry, false ceiling, electrical, plumbing, painting, and finishing work.
• Read and interpret drawings, layouts, BOQs, and material specifications to guide site execution.
• Coordinate with designers, project managers, contractors, vendors, and installation teams.
• Track progress against project schedules and promptly report delays, discrepancies, or execution challenges to the Project Manager / Senior Project Manager.
• Check site measurements, perform basic quantity calculations, and verify dimensions before production and installation.
• Monitor material deliveries, usage, storage, and requirements to minimise wastage and avoid delays.
• Inspect workmanship and finishes, identify defects, and follow up on corrections.
• Maintain daily progress reports, site photographs, attendance records, snag lists, pending work reports, and material requirement updates.
• Ensure site safety, housekeeping, and protection of installed materials and finished surfaces.
• Conduct basic quality and functional checks of electrical, plumbing, and hardware installations before handover, coordinating with the relevant technicians for testing and rectification.
• Assist with snag inspections, track closure of outstanding items, and support project handover.

Qualifications & Experience
• 1–2 years of relevant experience, with prior hands-on responsibility for day-to-day site supervision in interior projects.
• A B.Arch or degree/diploma in Interior Design or Civil Engineering is preferred.
• Working knowledge of AutoCAD and SketchUp is required.
• Ability to understand interior execution drawings and basic construction details.
• Basic understanding of Bills of Quantities (BOQs), quantity calculations, and material specifications.
• Practical knowledge of interior materials, installation methods, and finishing standards.

Skills & Language Requirements
• Good coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and a proactive approach to resolving site issues.
• Ability to manage daily work priorities and follow up with multiple teams.
• Hindi and English are required. Kannada will be an added advantage.
• Willingness to travel between project sites in Bangalore.
• Must have a two-wheeler to visit sites within the city. Travel allowance will be provided over and above salary.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description: Job Description The Site Supervisor is responsible for planning, supervising, and monitoring all demolition activities at project sites to ensure safe, timely, and efficient execution. The role also includes tracking the movement of assets from dismantling through dispatch, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring complete accountability of materials throughout the demolition process. Contract Duration: 30 to 60 days (will be extended based on the requirement) Notice Period: Immediate Joiner Key Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate day-to-day demolition/Dismantling activities at assigned project sites. Ensure demolition/Dismantling work is executed in accordance with approved work plans, project schedules, and statutory safety requirements. Monitor Vendor performance, manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and site productivity. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards. Ensure mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and adherence to safe work practices. Track the movement of assets from dismantling to storage, loading, dispatch, and final delivery to ensure complete traceability and accountability. Verify asset quantities against approved inventory/BOQ and report any discrepancies, shortages, or damages immediately. Maintain records of asset movement, dispatch details, gate passes, weighment records, delivery acknowledgements, and other related documentation. Coordinate with logistics teams, transporters, warehouse personnel, and customers to facilitate smooth asset movement. Prepare and submit Daily Progress Reports (DPRs) covering demolition progress, manpower deployment, equipment utilization, asset movement, dispatch status, safety observations, and site photographs. Identify operational risks, safety concerns, and project delays, and recommend corrective actions. Report site incidents, near misses, accidents, and non-conformities promptly and support corrective and preventive actions. Ensure demolition waste is segregated, handled, and disposed of in compliance with applicable environmental regulations. Coordinate with clients, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution. Verify completion of work against project milestones, quality standards, and contractual requirements. Participate in project review meetings and provide regular updates on project status, risks, and mitigation measures.

description:
Job Title : Site Supervisor - Civil & PEB

Location : Project Sites (PAN Bangalore, as assigned) Reporting To : Senior Site Engineer / Project Manager Type : Full time | Site-Based

About Us

We are a turnkey industrial construction firm delivering projects across industrial, warehousing, and commercial sectors with in-house PEB and civil teams. We are looking for motivated Site Supervisors with hands-on experience in basic site execution and supervision activities.

Key Responsibilities : Site Supervision & Execution

- Monitor daily construction activities at site and ensure adherence to work plans.
- Supervise site workers, subcontractors, and labor as per task allocation.
- Assist in site marking, foundation layout, and levelling using dumpy level or auto-level.
- Ensure correct execution of blockwork, plastering, PCC, RCC, and finishing works.
- Supervise erection activities during PEB assembly - bolt tightening, structural alignment, safety compliance.

Coordination & Reporting

- Maintain daily progress report (DPR) and update photographs.
- Coordinate with storekeeper for material issue and availability.
- Ensure curing schedules are followed and rework is avoided.
- Report site discrepancies, material shortages, or delays proactively to seniors.

Site Safety & Quality

- Ensure safety practices are followed by labor and supervisors on site.
- Check line, level, and plumb during civil works and PEB erection.
- Follow checklists for each work stage - marking, casting, de-shuttering, etc.

Requirements :

- Diploma/ITI in Civil or Mechanical Engineering.
- 1-2 years of experience in site supervision, preferably in PEB/Industrial projects.
- Basic understanding of drawings (plan, section, footing layout, elevation).
- Familiarity with dumpy level, survey tape, plumb bob, water level, etc.
- Ability to communicate clearly with labor teams and site engineers.
- Willingness to be posted at project sites across locations.

Job Types : Full-time, Fresher, Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits :

- Food provided
- Health insurance
- Life insurance
- Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
We're Hiring: Site Supervisor / Project Coordinator

ModScale is seeking a responsible and energetic Site Supervisor / Project Coordinator to support the successful execution of our projects. This role is ideal for someone with 1–2 years of site coordination or project supervision experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Key responsibilities:
• Supervise daily on-site activities and ensure work is completed as per the project plan.
• Coordinate with contractors, vendors, technicians, labour teams, and internal departments.
• Monitor work quality, safety practices, timelines, and material usage at the site.
• Assist in planning daily schedules and tracking project progress against agreed timelines.
• Maintain regular updates on site activities, completed work, delays, and pending requirements.
• Coordinate material deliveries and ensure required materials are available on time.
• Identify site-level issues early and coordinate with the relevant team to resolve them.
• Support measurements, work verification, basic documentation, and project reporting.
• Communicate professionally with clients and stakeholders when required.
• Help ensure each project is delivered on time and to ModScale's quality standards.

Candidate requirements:
• 1–2 years of experience as a Site Supervisor, Project Coordinator, Site Engineer, or in a similar role.
• Comfortable coordinating multiple teams and handling day-to-day site operations.
• Good communication, planning, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to read basic drawings and understand site execution requirements is preferred.
• Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
• A proactive, detail-oriented, and accountable approach to work.

Location: Bangalore
Salary: 20,000–35,000 per month, based on experience and skills.

If you are interested in building well-executed projects and growing with a collaborative team, we would love to connect.

To apply, please share your resume via LinkedIn or contact us directly on View phone number on foundit.in / [HIDDEN TEXT].

Vacant Position: 1

ERP ID: HR-OPN-2026-0049

Qualification: Any Graduate

Department: Signage

Job Location: Bengaluru PAN India

Location: PAN India Sites

Experience: At least 1 year of experience in Site Execution (signage, printing, fabrication, digital signage, or related industries is a plus)

Industry: Signage Manufacturing and Digital Signage

Objective

Responsible for managing site execution activities, ensuring accurate measurements, material verification, documentation, coordination with teams, and timely reporting while maintaining quality and safety standards at project sites.

Qualifications & Skills Required

• Diploma / ITI / Graduate in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related field.
• 1–3 years of experience in site supervision, installation, fabrication, signage, or project execution activities.
• Experience in handling site measurements, material management, and execution reporting.
• Knowledge of work at height safety practices.
• Willingness to travel PAN India and stay at project sites as required.

Key Responsibilities

• Site Measurement & Approval
• Conduct accurate measurements at site as per project requirements.
• Prepare and submit measurements in the required format.
• Share measurement details and required formats from site and obtain approval from the immediate senior before leaving the site.
• Site Execution & Installation Work
• Responsible for hands-on execution of site work independently, including installation and completion activities as per project requirements.
• Perform work at height activities with proper safety precautions and follow all required safety procedures.
• Ensure proper use of safety equipment (PPE, safety harness, helmet, etc.) during site execution.
• Ensure quality of work, finishing, and timely completion of assigned site activities.
• Remain present at ongoing execution sites and actively manage day-to-day site work.
• Material Verification & Management
• Check complete material availability at site as per BOM, including quantity and specifications.
• Verify available material before starting execution work.
• Report any shortage or missing material to the immediate senior on the first day itself.
• Coordinate and manage scaffolding movement from one site to another site or factory.
• Site Reporting & Documentation
• Share daily work execution reports in the morning and evening.
• Maintain all daily site documentation and required formalities.
• Share site photographs before starting and after completion of work.
• Before installation: Application area and structure/frame photographs.
• After installation: Final completed work photographs.
• Site Coordination & HOTO
• Collect materials or documents from the nearest courier location if dispatched from the office.
• Inform the immediate senior at least 3 days before site completion for HOTO (Hand Over Take Over) arrangement.
• Discuss and respond to queries raised by site officers related to executed work.

Key Competencies

• Responsible and safety-focused approach.
• Ability to independently execute site work.
• Attention to detail in measurements, installation, and documentation.
• Good coordination and problem-solving ability.

description:
Multi Skilled Technician (MEP) | Zolo | Coliving

Keep properties running. Close issues fast. Protect the living experience.

Company Name: ZoloStays

Designation: MEP

Location: Bangalore

Salary Range: up to 4 LPA (Subject to hike according to market standards)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 2 - 5 years in real estate

Why this role exists

In coliving, resident experience is not defined only at the time of move-in. It is defined every single day through how reliably the property functions.

Residents live in the property full-time.

This means:

• Electricity cannot fail frequently

• Water issues cannot remain unresolved

• Plumbing breakdowns cannot wait for days

• Common areas cannot remain dysfunctional

At scale, coliving operations face continuous pressure because:

• Properties operate at high occupancy density

• Asset usage is constant

• Wear and tear increases rapidly

• Repair tickets are ongoing, not occasional

In this environment, even small maintenance delays immediately affect:

• Resident satisfaction

• Complaint volume

• Property experience

• Operational efficiency

Most operational failures today happen because:

• Tickets remain open beyond timelines

• Temporary fixes are used instead of permanent resolution

• Teams depend excessively on external vendors

• Preventive maintenance is inconsistent

• Material tracking is weak, leading to delays and wastage

• Repeat issues occur due to poor technical diagnosis

This role exists to ensure:

• All maintenance issues are resolved within defined timelines

• Critical systems remain functional consistently

• Preventive maintenance reduces breakdowns proactively

• Maximum issues are solved in-house through technical ownership

• Material usage and inventory are tracked with discipline

If this role is strong:

• Properties remain reliable and functional

• Complaints reduce significantly

• Downtime remains low

• Operations become faster and more efficient

If this role is weak:

• Breakdowns repeat frequently

• Escalations increase

• Vendor dependency risesli>

• Resident experience deteriorates

This role directly controls:

Property uptime + issue resolution speed + operational reliability

Your mandate is clear

• Close all tickets within defined TAT with complete resolution

• Maintain uptime of all critical systems

• Execute preventive maintenance consistently

• Reduce vendor dependency through strong technical ownership

• Maintain discipline in material usage and tracking

This is not a technician role. This is a property uptime ownership role.

About Coliving Operations

Coliving operations are built on:

• Continuous uptime

• Fast issue resolution

• Reliable infrastructure

• High-density asset usage

The experience works only when:

• Systems function reliably every day

• Residents feel issues are resolved quickly

• Properties remain functional and well-maintained

• Maintenance execution is disciplined

At scale, uptime becomes one of the biggest drivers of customer trust.

This role directly impacts:

Resident experience + operational efficiency + property reliability

description:
Job Summary:
The CCTV Operator is responsible for monitoring and operating surveillance systems to ensure the safety and security of TCS premises, employees, clients, and assets. This role involves real-time monitoring of CCTV feeds, incident reporting, and coordination with security and emergency teams to maintain a secure environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Monitor live CCTV feeds across TCS facilities and data centers.
- Identify and report suspicious activities, security breaches, or safety hazards.
- Maintain accurate surveillance logs and incident reports.
- Coordinate with on-ground security personnel during emergencies.
- Ensure the proper functioning of CCTV cameras and recording systems.
- Report equipment malfunctions to the technical support team.
- Retrieve and provide recorded footage when required for investigations.
- Follow company security protocols and compliance standards.
- Maintain confidentiality of surveillance data and company information.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Arts, Commerce, Science; 3 years diploma holders can be considered.
- Candidates should not be minors.
- Hardware/Networking certification is an added advantage.
- Good interpersonal skills, adaptability, ethics, and cultural awareness are essential.
- Willingness to work long hours and travel as needed.
- Candidates should have a vehicle (two-wheeler).
- Must be disciplined and ethically strong, flexible, and adaptable.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office is required.
- Decent communication skills are necessary.
- B.E/BTech/MTech/MBA/MCA/MSC/B.Sc IT/B.Ed/Post Graduation (Non-Technical) candidates are not eligible for this role.

description:
We are looking for a Sales Support Associate to join our Sales Support team in Bangalore, Karnataka. This is an amazing opportunity to work on a key role supporting Sales Velocity. The team consists of 10+ members and is reporting to the Manager, Global Sales Support. We have a great skill set in Sales Operations and we would love to speak with you if you have skills in Salesforce adoption, Training and Supporting users globally.

About You

• Must have minimum 1 year experience working in Customer Service environment (CRM Platform/Phone/Email/Chat) or similar role.
• Must have a knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM system and supporting the Sales Cycle business processes would be an added advantage.
• Solid business acumen of business transactions and end-to-end sales processes.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to apply knowledge and creativity to resolve standard and complex client issues, improving service offerings.
• Strong communication skills (written, oral, presentation) with the field, account management, customers, and internal management.

It would be great if you have . . .

• Sales Operations understanding about the basic roles and responsibilities.
• Problem solving skills within sales order process, billing systems, incentives, contract management, business policies skills.

What will you be doing in this role?

• Ascertain effective ongoing support for daily opportunity to order matters including support for renewal processing, change requests and responding to end-user inquiries.
• Identify opportunities for improvements in sales process efficiency and effectiveness. Partner with BIS to develop and implement solutions
• Provide a professional, dedicated and customer focused service to all queries received from all stakeholders and Interpret requests, analyze results and provide support that adheres to customer contracts and Clarivate norms
• Use internal tools to understand requests and make key changes that will meet the needs of all the customers and colleagues. Liaise with other stakeholders as needed to ensure that the Quote details are accurate and consistent, and the Quote is of the highest accuracy and detail
• Ensure that the steps taken comply to the steps outlined in the Quote administrator runbook. Contribute and evolve Quote administrator Runbook.
• Support with release of Salesforce sales process enhancements such as facilitating technical development information into user friendly adoption. Develop effective working relationships with sales managers and collaborate with partner groups providing service to the business.

About the Team

The Sales Support team is about supporting and enabling frontline sales teams to sell more efficiently and effectively by providing strategic direction and reducing friction in the sales process. To do this, sales ops fulfills both strategic and tactical functions. We work with most of the other support functions within Clarivate.

Hours of Work

Monday to Friday, 9.00 AM to 6.00 PM IST (includes one hour break)
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

description:
We are seeking a motivated B2B Sales Associate to join our dynamic team in the Karnataka and Mumbai region. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by establishing and maintaining relationships with business clients. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying new business opportunities and effectively communicating the value of our products and services to potential customers.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve targets and expand our customer base.
- Identify and engage potential B2B clients through networking, cold calling, and referrals.
- Conduct presentations and product demonstrations to showcase our offerings.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to align sales strategies with promotional campaigns.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities for growth.
- Prepare and present sales reports to management, providing insights on performance and areas for improvement.

Required Skills:
- Proven experience in B2B sales, preferably in a similar industry.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with clients.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent negotiation and closing skills.
- Familiarity with sales software and CRM tools is a plus.

If you are passionate about sales and eager to contribute to a growing company, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in driving success and making a significant impact in the B2B market.

description:
Job Title: Lab Technician-Hadapsar

Company Name: Manipal Hospitals

Job Description:

The Lab Technician at Manipal Hospitals will be responsible for conducting various laboratory tests and procedures to assist in the diagnosis and treatment of patients. The technician will ensure that all laboratory equipment is functioning properly and will adhere to safety and quality protocols. Responsibilities include preparing samples, performing tests, recording results, and maintaining laboratory records. The Lab Technician will also collaborate with medical staff to discuss test results and contribute to patient care.

Key Responsibilities:

• Perform a variety of laboratory tests including blood, urine, and other bodily fluid analyses.

• Prepare specimens and ensure proper labeling and storage.

• Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, troubleshooting issues as needed.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and maintain a clean and organized laboratory environment.

• Record and report test results accurately and in a timely manner.

• Assist in the calibration and validation of laboratory instruments.

• Collaborate with healthcare professionals to ensure quality patient care.

• Participate in continuing education and training to stay updated on laboratory practices and technologies.

Skills and Tools Required:

• Diploma or Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related field.

• Strong knowledge of laboratory procedures and safety protocols.

• Proficient in using laboratory equipment such as centrifuges, microscopes, and analyzers.

• Attention to detail and strong analytical skills for accurate test results.

• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills for collaboration with healthcare teams.

• Familiarity with laboratory information systems (LIS) and electronic health records (EHR).

• Ability to comply with health and safety regulations.

This is a full-time position based in Hadapsar, and the ideal candidate will demonstrate commitment to quality patient care and professional development.

Company: Image Core Lab

Location: Bangalore

Job Summary:

Image Core Lab is looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Imaging Processing Technologist to support imaging analysis, AI validation, and clinical imaging workflows. The ideal candidate should have a foundational understanding of radiology imaging, anatomy, and medical image processing.

Key Responsibilities:

Perform quality checks for imaging data to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Assist radiologists in analyzing and interpreting medical scans.
Conduct clinical validation and verification for AI tasks to ensure accuracy and reliability.

Support imaging workflows and maintain data quality standards.
Identify and segment tumors and other imaging findings as required for clinical and AI projects.

Foundational understanding of human anatomy and radiology imaging.
Familiarity with tumour identification and segmentation.
Basic understanding of CT, MRI, PET, or other imaging modalities is preferred.
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with radiologists and cross-functional teams.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualification:

Bachelor’s/Masters degree in Medical Imaging Technology.
Prior exposure to medical imaging, AI annotation, or clinical imaging workflows will be an added advantage.

Locations: Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Indore, Guwahati, Madurai, Mysore and Mumbai.

description:
We are looking for caring, responsible, and hardworking Patient Care Assistants / Ward Care Assistants to join our rehabilitation centre. The role involves assisting patients with their daily care needs and supporting the nursing and rehabilitation team in maintaining patient comfort, safety, hygiene, and cleanliness.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist patients with bathing, grooming, dressing, and personal hygiene.
- Assist with transferring and repositioning patients safely.
- Provide support to patients who have difficulty walking or moving.
- Assist with feeding patients as instructed by the nursing team.
- Carry out regular patient positioning as per the care plan.
- Assist nurses and other healthcare staff with patient-care activities.
- Help maintain cleanliness and hygiene in patient rooms and ward areas.
- Assist with changing bed sheets and maintaining patient surroundings.
- Support patients during physiotherapy and other rehabilitation activities when required.
- Observe patients and immediately report any changes or concerns to the nurse in charge.
- Follow instructions given by nurses, doctors, and supervisors.
- Ensure patient safety while moving, transferring, or assisting patients.
- Maintain a respectful, patient, and compassionate attitude towards patients and their families.
- Follow all centre rules, infection-control practices, and safety procedures.
- Perform other patient-care responsibilities assigned by the supervisor.

Preferred Candidate

- Previous experience in a hospital, rehabilitation centre, nursing home, or home-care setting is preferred.
- Candidates with experience caring for bedridden, stroke, paralysed, elderly, or dependent patients will be preferred.
- Basic understanding of patient hygiene, feeding, positioning, and mobility assistance.
- Physically fit and able to assist patients with transfers and positioning.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
- Should be responsible, punctual, and willing to work in shifts.
- Should have a caring and respectful attitude towards patients.

Qualification

- Minimum: 10th / 12th standard preferred.
- Healthcare or patient-care experience will be an advantage.

Shift

- Rotational shifts
- Weekly off as per duty roster

What We Offer

- Competitive salary
- Supportive working environment
- Chance to work in a rehabilitation and patient-care setting
- Training and guidance for patient-care responsibilities

Pay: From ₹17,000.00 per month

description:
About ZypHeal

ZypHeal is a premium home healthcare platform for affluent urban India, delivering virtual doctor consultations, home nursing, physiotherapy, phlebotomy and diagnostics, medicine delivery, vaccination, nutrition counselling, and mental health support directly at the customer's home. Unlike gig-marketplace models, ZypHeal's clinical staff are salaried, full-time employees of the company — not independent contractors booked through a marketplace. This is a deliberate choice: it is what lets us guarantee consistent quality, consistent brand experience, and a genuine standard of care on every visit, and it is central to how we are building trust with our customers.

Role Summary

As a ZypHeal Home Nurse, you deliver pre-booked, in-home nursing care to our customers — administering clinical procedures safely and compassionately, and acting as the trusted, reassuring clinical presence of the ZypHeal brand inside someone's home.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical care delivery
• Injections (IV / IM / SC)
• Elderly companion care
• Wound dressing and dressing changes
• Oxygen therapy assistance
• Nebulization assistance
• Diabetes management support
• Insulin administration
• Bedridden patient care

Visit standards
• Arrive at the customer's home within the scheduled visit window, in ZypHeal uniform, with all required kit and consumables.
• Confirm identity, consent, and the booked procedure before beginning any clinical activity, per ZypHeal's home-visit consent protocol.
• Maintain accurate, timely documentation of every visit (vitals, procedure performed, observations) in the ZypHeal app.
• Escalate promptly to the on-call virtual doctor for any case outside your scope, or any deterioration in the patient's condition.
• Maintain strict hygiene, infection control, and biomedical waste disposal standards on every visit.

What we're looking for
• Minimum 2 years of relevant hands-on clinical work experience (hospital, home care, or clinic setting).
• GNM / B.Sc. Nursing (or equivalent recognized nursing qualification).
• Valid state nursing/professional council registration and license to practice, in good standing.
• Comfortable working independently at a patient's home without on-site physician supervision, while coordinating with a virtual doctor as needed.
• Strong communication and bedside manner — this is a premium, trust-led brand; every interaction should feel unhurried, careful and personal.
• Willingness to travel within an assigned geo-fenced zone for scheduled home visits.
• Basic digital literacy — comfortable using a smartphone app for visit schedules, documentation and reporting.

description:
PEP Schoolv2 | Montessori Primary Educator (2-6 years)

Full-time | HSR Layout, Varthur, Sarjapura, Whitefield

The work

There is something quietly powerful about watching a three-year-old discover they can pour without spilling, tie their shoes, or sound out their first words. These are not small moments. They are the foundation for everything that comes after: concentration, independence, confidence, and joy in mastery.

At PEP Schoolv2, we take the early years seriously. Not in the rigid, academic-pressure way that many preschools have adopted, but in the way Maria Montessori intended: by creating prepared environments where children develop naturally at their own pace, and build capabilities that serve them for life.

We call ourselves “v2” because we are intentionally building a better version of school. More respectful of child development, more thoughtful about how learning happens, and more personal in how we guide each child.

We are looking for educators who love this work and feel excited by early childhood development. Montessori training is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to observe, guide with care, and commit to the craft. We can train the right candidate.

What you will do

Create and maintain a prepared environment

Every material has its place, every activity has a purpose, and the room itself teaches order, care, and independence.

Observe deeply and personalize the path

Watch each child closely to understand where they are developmentally. Notice what draws their attention. Recognize readiness. Document growth in a systematic, practical way.

Guide, do not direct

Present materials at the right moment. Model precise movements. Offer just enough support. Then step back and let the child work. Your timing and restraint are part of the craft.

Support the whole child

Children build foundations in language, early math, sensorial development, movement, and practical life. They also learn emotional regulation, conflict resolution, grace and courtesy, and how to be part of a community.

Partner with parents

Share observations thoughtfully. Help families understand Montessori in clear, grounded terms. Address questions with empathy and confidence. Our parents are involved and educated, and they value depth.

Collaborate and grow

Work closely with other educators, participate in team meetings, and keep refining your practice. PEP Schoolv2 is founder-led by a team with IIT and IIM backgrounds and experience in places like McKinsey and Amazon, so we bring strong systems, high standards, and continuous improvement into how we operate and support teachers.

Requirements
• Montessori training is preferred, but not essential
• If you are the right fit, PEP Schoolv2 offers internal training and mentoring to help you grow into strong Montessori practice
• Bachelor’s degree (required)
• Experience with young children preferred (not mandatory if your aptitude is strong)
• Fluency in English (required)

About PEP Schoolv2

We're a school network founded by IIT-IIM alumni, operating across Bangalore and Hyderabad, serving 400+ students from preschool through Grade 10. Our adolescent program (Grades 6-10) takes a distinctive approach: small group instruction, personalized learning paths, and systematic application of learning science.

We are looking for a passionate, dedicated and enthusiastic Mother Teacher for Grade 1 to handle primary-level students and teach English, Mathematics and Environmental Studies (EVS). The candidate should have excellent teaching skills, patience and the ability to create a positive, engaging and child-friendly learning environment.

• Handle Grade 1 students as a Mother Teacher.
• Teach English, Mathematics and EVS as per the prescribed curriculum.
• Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, teaching aids and classroom activities.
• Make learning interactive, activity-based and enjoyable for young learners.
• Develop students' reading, writing, communication and basic mathematical skills.
• Monitor students' academic progress and maintain assessment records.
• Maintain classroom discipline and ensure the overall well-being of students.
• Communicate regularly with parents regarding students' academic performance and development.
• Participate in school activities, meetings and other academic responsibilities.

Desired Candidate Profile
• Graduate / Postgraduate in any relevant discipline.
• B.Ed / D.El.Ed / NTT qualification preferred.
• 2–5 years of teaching experience in a reputed school, preferably at the primary level.
• Strong subject knowledge in English, Mathematics and EVS.
• Excellent communication and classroom management skills.
• Should be patient, caring, creative and passionate about teaching young children.
• Ability to use innovative and activity-based teaching methodologies.

Primary Teaching | Mother Teacher | Grade 1 Teaching | English | Mathematics | EVS | Lesson Planning | Classroom Management | Child-Centric Teaching | Student Assessment

description:
We are looking for a Bulk Kitchen Chef to join our team at Triveni Logistic Solutions Private Limited and prepare delicious meals for the guests. Key responsibility includes preparing and delivering high-quality dishes, setting up the menu, and delegating tasks to kitchen staff (If needed). The position offers an in-hand salary of ₹ 45,000 - ₹ 50,000.

Key Responsibilities:
• Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations within the kitchen area.
• Set up the kitchen with cooking utensils and equipment.
• Cook food in a timely manner.
• Study each recipe and gather all necessary ingredients.
• Supervise cooks and assist as needed.
• Slightly modify recipes to meet customers’ needs and requests (example: No dairy, exclude nuts).
• Check the freshness of food and discard out-of-date items.

Job Requirements:

The minimum qualification for this role is Graduate and candidate must be a fresher. Familiarity with cooking techniques (advance & non-traditional), recipes, and sanitation regulations are ideal for the position. The role requires excellent time management and leadership skills. A culinary school diploma or certification in a similar field is a plus.
