description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
About the NATS Program:

This role is offered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), a flagship initiative of the Government of India designed to equip Indian youth with practical, trade-specific skills. Administered under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended in 1973), this program at Volvo Group offers engineering graduates and diploma holders a structured, 1-year practical, hands-on On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunity to build industry-ready capabilities.

What you will do

At Volvo Group, you will take your first steps into Talent Acquisition and contribute to building the teams that shape our future.
• You will learn the fundamentals of recruitment, from understanding job requirements to sourcing candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and referrals.
• You will review resumes, conduct initial candidate calls, and coordinate interviews, always keeping communication clear and timely with both candidates and hiring teams.
• Beyond daily recruitment tasks, you will support talent acquisition initiatives, maintain accurate trackers and records, and provide regular updates on hiring progress.

This role gives you a real, end-to-end view of recruitment, and the chance to grow into a confident, capable Talent Acquisition Partner.

Your future team

You will join our Talent Acquisition team in Bangalore, a group of experienced TA partners who value collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning. We work closely together, share knowledge openly, and support each other through every hiring cycle, creating an environment where new ideas and questions are always welcome.

Who are you?

You are an undergraduate with a bachelor's degree in any discipline
• You bring excellent verbal and written communication skills, a confident and professional approach to conversations, and genuine interest in people and in Human Resources.
• You learn quickly, take feedback well, and stay organized even when juggling multiple priorities and deadlines.
• You are comfortable with MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and you take ownership of your work with a proactive, can-do attitude.
• Experience with college events, student clubs, placement coordination, or internships in HR is welcome but not required; what matters most is your curiosity and your drive to learn.

What's in it for you?

We offer a solid foundation for your career in Talent Acquisition, plus you will enjoy:

• Structured, hands-on training covering the full recruitment lifecycle.
• Direct exposure to candidates, TA partners, and hiring managers from day one.
• A collaborative team culture that values learning and mutual support.
• Real opportunities to grow your skills and build a long-term career in People & Culture.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who we are and what we believe in
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

description:
Requisition ID: 36306

Job Role: Graduate Apprentice Trainee - Data Science

Job Category: Supply Chain & Logistics

Organization: Trucks Technology & Industrial

Location: Hosakote

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and analytical Graduate Apprentice Trainee (GAT) – Data Science to join our Data Science and Analytics team.

This entry-level role provides fresh graduates with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in data preparation, analytics, visualisation, statistical modelling, Machine Learning and AI. The selected candidate will work under the guidance of experienced Data Scientists and collaborate with business and technical teams to understand business challenges and support data-driven decision-making.

We value curiosity, logical thinking and a willingness to learn. Prior work experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming and validating data from different sources.

Prepare and analyse datasets using Python, SQL and tools such as Databricks.

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends and useful insights.

Support the development and testing of basic analytical and Machine Learning models for forecasting, prediction and classification.

Assist in building dashboards, reports and visualisations using Power BI or similar tools.

Collaborate with Data Scientists and business teams to understand requirements and support data-driven solutions.

Document data sources, assumptions, analysis and key findings.

Contribute to data-quality improvements and identify opportunities to apply Data Science, Machine Learning and AI to business challenges.

Communicate findings clearly through reports, dashboards and presentations.

What You'll Gain

Hands-on experience solving real-world business challenges.

Guidance and mentorship from experienced Data Scientists and analytics professionals.

Exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, AI and business analytics projects.

Opportunities to develop technical, analytical and communication skills.

A supportive environment for continuous learning and professional growth.

Key Competencies

Analytical and Logical Thinking

Problem Solving

Attention to Detail

Innovation and Curiosity

Collaboration and Teamwork

Continuous Learning

Effective Communication

Required Behavioral Competencies

Curiosity and willingness to learn new concepts and technologies.

Structured approach to problem-solving.

Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to explain technical findings in simple language.

Ability to work independently on assigned tasks with appropriate guidance.

Willingness to collaborate, receive feedback and continuously improve.

Good time-management skills and a sense of responsibility.

Responsible handling of data and confidential information.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

Basic understanding of statistics, probability and data analysis concepts.

Basic programming knowledge in Python.

Familiarity with SQL and fundamental database concepts.

Introductory understanding of Machine Learning and its applications.

Strong logical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

Willingness to learn new tools and technologies and apply analytical thinking to practical business problems.

Digitide started with a simple vision: to transform business operations and drive growth for enterprises across the globe.

For over 20 years, weve been at the forefront of this mission, creating lasting impact through AI-led digital solutions, smart business processes, and deep industry expertise. Our journey began as a partner to businesses looking to enhance operational efficiency and customer experiences. By combining the power of AI, data intelligence, and business process services, weve been able to help our customers master the digital age and stay ahead of the curve.

With a global presence across 40 locations in 5 countries and a team of 55,000 dedicated associates, we deliver transformative solutions that help businesses adapt, evolve, and thrive in a constantly changing world. Were more than just a service provider were a committed partner driving meaningful impact every day. We leverage global expertise and local insights to help customers navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. With a focus on innovation, collaboration, and results, we continue to pave the way for the future of business.

As an Apprentice Customer Care representative, you will be an integral part of our team, providing exceptional support to our customers. Your primary focus will be on delivering an outstanding customer experience, ensuring their needs are met, and resolving any queries or issues they may have. This role offers a great learning environment, where you can develop your communication, problem-solving, and customer service skills.

Handle customer inquiries and provide accurate, timely responses.
Resolve customer complaints and ensure their satisfaction.
Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times.
Collaborate with the team to improve customer service processes.
Document and update customer records and information.
Stay updated with product knowledge and company policies.
Provide feedback and suggestions to enhance customer care strategies.
Assist in training and mentoring new team members.
Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-centric approach.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Proficiency in using customer relationship management (CRM) systems.
Basic knowledge of BFSI industry is preferred.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new processes and technologies.
Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
Positive attitude and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.

description:
Company Description

At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.

Job Description

We are now looking for Diploma Trainee who is passionate about working with our Crane Service team. In this role, you will be responsible for services and maintenance at site location.

Your key role:

- Work assignments are planned by the branch (service planner) and assigned to the Trainee.
- The Trainee accepts work packages and enters work against the SR/WP.
- The Trainee cannot create new service requests (except through “do work”).
- Record faults/exceptions using Risk & Recommendation method,
- Estimate labour hours and parts cost for repairs.
- Perform Safety Review and Visit Review and record next steps.
- Consult with our customers to permit informed buying decisions based on recommendations made.
- Awareness of ISO 14001 & 45001 standard

Qualifications

Qualification: Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical

Competencies and skills we expect for this role:

- Good written and verbal communication in English, any other language is a plus
- Ability to work in teams
- Knowledge of MS Office

description:
Diploma Apprentice Trainee (NATS 2.0) | Diploma Freshers

Location: Bangalore / South India (Hybrid Training Model)

Internship Duration: Diploma holders 1 Year

Stipend: 15,000 per month

Program: NATS 2.0 Apprenticeship Program

About the Opportunity

We are inviting applications from fresh Engineering and Diploma graduates for an exciting Apprenticeship/Internship opportunity under the NATS 2.0 Program. This program offers hands-on industry exposure, technical training, and the potential to transition into permanent roles based on performance.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the following requirements:
Passed out in 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026
Minimum 60% aggregate in 10th, 12th, Diploma, or B.E./B.Tech
No active backlogs
No academic gaps between educational qualifications
Must possess a valid Provisional Certificate or Degree Completion Certificate
Should not have previously undergone any apprenticeship under NATS
Should not be currently enrolled in any NATS apprenticeship program
Should not have worked in any organization for more than 6 months (employment history will be verified through UAN records)
Preference for candidates from South India, with willingness to travel to Bangalore as required

Open Positions

Diploma Holders
Mechanical Engineering: 50 Positions
Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE): 20 Positions

Training & Work Model
80% Virtual Training
20% On-site Training in Bangalore
Hybrid learning and practical exposure on live projects
Industry-relevant technical and professional skill development

Growth opportunities Opportunities Successful apprentices may be considered for permanent employment opportunities based on:
Technical Assessment
Aptitude Test Performance
Overall Internship Performance

Perks
Monthly stipend: 15,000
Structured learning under NATS 2.0
Industry exposure and mentorship
Opportunity for full time employment after successful completion

Application Process Eligible shortlisted candidates will receive detailed registration instructions and onboarding steps for the NATS 2.0 apprenticeship program
